t: You're looking at The Arch, a large stone sculpture by Henry Moore, made between 1979 and 1980. It stands in Kensington Gardens, and Moore gave it to the park himself in 1980. Moore is best known for semi-abstract monumental sculptures, mostly in bronze, placed around the world as public art. This one is carved in stone. He also drew Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War, so this is a gift from an artist with a real connection to the city.
